title: Factor.AI
tagline: Factor.AI is an innovative platform built on the cutting-edge Galadriel Blockchain. By conversing with our AI, users can directly influence the characteristics of the tokens they create, including the choice of blockchain.

prizes.title: Most unique on-chain AI application built on Galadriel

description:
Factor.AI is an advanced platform that revolutionizes token creation on the blockchain by combining AI technology with blockchain capabilities. Developed using Next.js for a seamless user experience, it builds on a forked version of a GPT-like model originally crafted by Galadriel blockchain developers. This enhanced model introduces custom features, enabling users to create and specify token details through conversation with the AI, such as name, ticker, supply, and the choice of blockchain network—Chiliz, Arbitrum, or Galadriel.

The project leverages Galadriel's oracle to execute smart contracts based on AI interactions, making the deployment of tokens straightforward and user-friendly. Factor.AI not only democratizes the process of token creation but also simplifies adding these tokens to users' wallets, offering a comprehensive solution from creation to wallet integration.
how_its_made:
Factor.AI is built on a modern web and blockchain tech stack, focusing on simplicity and efficiency. Here's a streamlined overview of the key technologies used:

- **Next.js**: The core framework for the user interface, enabling fast, server-side rendered pages.
- **Ethers.js**: Allows blockchain interactions, including smart contract deployment and wallet connections.
- **React**: Powers the dynamic UI components for an interactive user experience.
- **Tailwind CSS & Sass**: Used for styling, offering a flexible and efficient way to design the UI.
- **Axios**: Handles HTTP requests for external API interactions.
- **Prettier & ESLint**: Ensures code quality and consistency.
- **TypeScript**: Adds static typing to JavaScript, improving reliability and developer experience.

These technologies work together to enable Factor.AI's innovative features, from AI-driven token creation to blockchain integration and user wallet management.
